'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tom Schwarz LS We Have A Plan (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Schwarz]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan (V) / They Will Be Lost And Confused (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|OVS16-11-We_Have_A_Plan-remaster.webp|label=We Have A Plan (V) / They Will Be Lost And Confused (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Thomas-Tom Schwarz
* '''Username:''' Karakagin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
